intent: The 44px tap-target floor becomes a token, size.control.min, and the two button constants spend it. Nothing visible moves.
rationale: system.json states 'tap targets are at least 44x44px' as a principle and provides no token for the number: the space scale runs 32px then 48px, so both button constants in src/presentation/components/control.ts spend the raw utility min-h-11 — a value the design system owns stated in a vocabulary it does not. control.ts itself filed this (the-button-primitive-has-no-tokens, GitHub #108). The token is now in system.json under size.control.min; this ticket is the wiring that makes it real rather than decorative: tools/generate-theme.mjs currently emits no size group, so the token exists and nothing can reference it. The ghost and danger variants the button primitive declares stay deliberately undefined — no surface renders either, and defining treatments for variants nothing shows is designing fiction; they get their values with the first surface that needs them.

design.layout: No layout change. This ticket moves one value from a raw utility into the token pipeline.

default.content: Unchanged. Rendered min-height stays 44px; only its source moves from the raw utility min-h-11 to a generated utility backed by size.control.min.

hover.content: Unchanged — treatment untouched by this ticket.

focused.content: Unchanged — the global focus-visible ring is untouched.

active.content: Unchanged — treatment untouched by this ticket (DT-0004 defines it).

content.generator: tools/generate-theme.mjs additionally emits the size group: a CSS custom property per leaf (--gc-size-control-min) and a Tailwind extend.minHeight entry keyed 'control', so min-h-control resolves to var(--gc-size-control-min). system.json stays the single writer; hand-editing tailwind.theme.json stays pointless.

acceptance: system.json carries size.control.min: 44px and remains the only place the number is stated
tools/generate-theme.mjs emits --gc-size-control-min and a minHeight.control Tailwind extension sourced from it
min-h-11 appears nowhere under src/ or app/ — BUTTON_PRIMARY and BUTTON_SECONDARY reference the generated min-h-control utility instead
The rendered min-height of both buttons is 44px before and after — this ticket changes no pixel
control.ts's header comment about the missing token is updated to say the token now exists, so the file stops filing a bug that is fixed

references.value: Backlog: the-button-primitive-has-no-tokens (GitHub #108) — this ticket is its first folded gap. Implement before DT-0004.
